title: DDNM
paper_title: Zero-Shot Image Restoration Using Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Model
core_mech: DDNM 用 A†y 固定 range-space 信息，只让 diffusion denoiser 生成 null-space 分量。
core_mech_en: Decomposes reverse diffusion intermediate estimates x̂_{0|t} via the Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse A† into a fixed measurement range-space component A†y and a generated null-space component (I − A†A)x̂_{0|t}.
input_desc: 线性退化测量 y=Ax+n、已知 A 及伪逆 A†、预训练无条件扩散模型
input_en: Linear measurement y = Ax + n, known operator A with pseudoinverse A†, and a pretrained unconditional diffusion model
output_desc: 满足或近似满足测量约束的恢复图像样本
output_en: Zero-shot restored image satisfying A x̂ = y while filling null-space details via the diffusion prior

adapter.name: DDNM
adapter.mechanism: Replace estimated x0's measurement-range component with A-dagger y while retaining its null-space component.
limitations: Noiseless inpainting where A-dagger=A; DDNM+ noisy-data and time-travel variants are not included.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
